units.source_text: 这盘棋进行到中盘就暂停。

en.t: This game was suspended once it had reached the middle game.

units.source_text: 况且是同名人对弈，其他棋手不好对胜负妄加猜测。

en.t: Besides, since it was a game against the Master himself, the other players could hardly make reckless guesses about who would win or lose.

units.source_text: 更重要的是，我很想听听有关名人和大竹七段的棋法。

en.t: More importantly, I very much wanted to hear about the playing styles of the Master and Otake Seventh Dan.

units.source_text: 也就是说，把这盘棋当作艺术品，从鉴赏棋风的角度加以评论。

en.t: In other words, I wanted the game to be treated as a work of art and discussed from the standpoint of appreciating its style of play.
